checked_boundaries.assessment: Final-path existing live/dangling symlinks are rejected; exclusive creation does not follow a competing final symlink. _owned uses lstat regular-file and device/inode comparison with the held descriptor. Final writes use the held file handle, never reopen/truncate a replaced foreign path. JSON is validated before own marker truncation, log ownership is checked before flush/read, and path replacement before finalization fails.

proof.excerpt:
def _owned(path, handle):
        current, original = path.lstat(), os.fstat(handle.fileno())
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode) or
                (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) != (original.st_dev, original.st_ino)):
            raise ValueError('Reserved evidence path changed; preserve and inspect the outputs')

def _write_json(self, payload):
